Our Story

A place built around your comfort, from arrival to checkout.

Elimwood Hotel sits just across the bridge from Historic St. Charles Main Street, close enough to walk into an evening of dining and entertainment, quiet enough to fall fast asleep after.

Whether you're in town for a meeting, a weekend tournament, or a family visit to St. Louis, we've shaped every part of the stay — from the renovated fitness center to the breakfast spread — around making it easy.

"Relax your body. Rest your mind. Revive your spirit."
